Artichoke leaf extract: Early trials suggest it may help lower liver enzymes in people with fatty liver disease, though larger human studies are still needed. Vitamin E: Sometimes used under medical supervision for specific fatty liver cases, but high doses carry health risks and are not recommended for general liver support. N-Acetylcysteine (NAC): Used medically in hospitals for acetaminophen overdose; evidence is limited for everyday liver health in healthy individuals.
